about: Every package script and every tool entry point under scripts/, with what it is for, what it touches and how long it usually takes. tests/unit/tool-catalogue.test.mjs fails on an unregistered or dangling entry. Durations are typical on the owner's Windows machine and were estimated, not timed.

effectClasses.read-only: Reads files or git state only (temporary directories it cleans up do not count)
effectClasses.writes-repo-files: Rewrites tracked files (formatting, generated documents, baselines)
effectClasses.writes-artifacts: Writes ignored outputs such as dist/, artifacts/ or build caches
effectClasses.network: Talks to a remote service (GitHub, Cloudflare, Firebase, package registries)
effectClasses.deploys: Publishes something players or the wiki can see
effectClasses.starts-server: Runs a local server until stopped

durations.long: over 10 minutes, or runs until stopped
